title: ADR whose id does not match the required pattern
context: An ADR whose id lacks the zero-padded numeric prefix.
decision: Test that an id without the numeric prefix is rejected.
consequences: The id would not sort or resolve as an ADR id.
invariants: The id must match the ADR id pattern.
forbiddenDrift: Do not use a non-conforming ADR id.
aiAlignmentRules: Stop if the ADR id does not match the required pattern.
permittedChanges: The id may be corrected to match the pattern by a recorded decision.
description: Defect: id does not match ^[0-9]{4}-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ because it lacks the four-digit prefix.
aiGuidance: This instance must be rejected because the id does not match the ADR id pattern.
